info.title: Payment Policies API
info.description:
The Payment Policies API allows VTEX merchants to configure rules that include or exclude payment systems for specific cart items. The Payment Configuration Service (PCS) stores policy rules, while the Payment Information Service (PIS) evaluates those rules during checkout and returns the payment systems available for each item.

> ⚠️ This feature is in closed beta, meaning only specific customers can access it now. If you want to implement it in the future, please contact [our Support](https://support.vtex.com/hc/en-us/).

## Rule engine

Policy rule expressions use [JSONLogic](https://jsonlogic.com/) and are evaluated for each cart item separately. All active rules that match an item are applied. Rules are applied in ascending `priority` order, and the result is the same in any order: `Exclude` removes the listed payment systems, and `Include` keeps only the listed payment systems, but never restores a payment system removed by `Exclude`.

### Context variables

| Variable | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collectionIds` | Array of integers | Collections that the item belongs to. An empty, null, or missing list produces the same result. |
| `seller` | String | Seller that fulfills the item. An empty or whitespace-only value is treated as not sent. |
| `shippingData.state` | String | Delivery state code, such as `NY`. An empty or whitespace-only value is treated as not sent. |

> ⚠️ Variable names aren't validated when a rule is saved. Any other name is treated as a missing field: comparisons using `==` and `in` with that field return `false`, while comparisons using `!=` return `true`. Logical operators combine these results normally.

### Operators

| Operator | Usage rules |
| --- | --- |
| `and`, `or` | Every operand must be a condition (object). Literal values are rejected. |
| `in` | Requires two operands. Each operand is a value, a list, or `{"var": "path"}`. When the second operand is a list, the type and value must match: `"139"` isn't in `[139]`. |
| `==` | Requires two operands. Each operand is `{"var": "path"}`, a non-empty string other than `"null"`, or an integer. Booleans, decimals, and lists are rejected. A number is equal to the string of the same number: `"1" == 1` is `true`. |
| `!=` | Same rules as `==`. Returns the opposite result. |
| `!` | Negates exactly one condition: `{"!": {...}}` or `{"!": [{...}]}`. Literal values and a standalone `var` are rejected. |
| `var` | Field path as a string. Use a dot to access nested fields, such as `shippingData.state`. Default values aren't supported. |

Any other operator is rejected with status `422`. There's no `not in` operator; use `{"!": {"in": [...]}}` instead.

Each expression can have up to 500 operators. The `and`, `or`, `!`, `in`, `==`, and `!=` operators count toward this limit, and `var` doesn't.

When an item doesn't have a field used by a comparison, `in` and `==` return `false`, and `!=` returns `true`. `!` negates the result of its child condition, so negating a missing-field `==` or `in` comparison returns `true`, while negating a missing-field `!=` comparison returns `false`. To prevent a negation from matching items without the field, require the field with `and`, as in `{"and": [{"var": "seller"}, {"!": {...}}]}`.

## Error messages

Policy rule endpoints return errors in the [Problem Details](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) format, with the `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, and `instance` fields. The following tables list the `detail` values. Errors returned by the expression validator may include additional parameter information at the end of the message.

### 400 Bad Request

| When | `detail` |
| --- | --- |
| The request body is missing `expression`, `enabled`, `priority`, or `action`. Messages for all missing fields are returned together. | `Expression is required. enabled is required. priority is required. action is required.` |
| `action` has a value other than `Include` or `Exclude`, including a different capitalization. | `action must be Include or Exclude.` |

### 422 Unprocessable Content

| When | `detail` |
| --- | --- |
| The expression uses an unsupported operator. | `Unsupported expression: JSONLogic operator "!==" is not supported.` |
| An operator object has more than one key. | `Unsupported expression: operator object must contain exactly one property, found "!=", "foo".` |
| `==`, `!=`, or `in` doesn't have exactly two operands. | `Unsupported expression: "!=" must have exactly two operands.` |
| `!` negates a literal value or a standalone `var`. | `Unsupported expression: "!" must negate exactly one condition, not a literal or a bare var.` |
| `and` or `or` has a literal value as an operand. | `Unsupported expression: every operand of "and" must be a condition, not a literal.` |
| `==` or `!=` has a boolean or decimal operand. | `Unsupported expression: inside "==", each operand must be {"var":"path"}, a non-empty string other than "null", or an integer.` |
| `==`, `!=`, or `in` has `null` or `"null"` as an operand. | `Unsupported expression: null is not allowed as a literal inside "==", "!=" or "in", neither as JSON null nor as the string "null".` |
| `==`, `!=`, or `in` has an empty or whitespace-only string as an operand. | `Unsupported expression: an empty or whitespace string is not allowed as a literal inside "==", "!=" or "in".` |
| `var` has a default value. | `Unsupported expression: inside "in", {"var": ...} must be a single string path (default values are not supported).` |
| The expression has more than 500 operators. | `Expression exceeds maximum conditionals (500). Found: 501.` |
| `priority` is outside the `0` to `999` range. A blank `name` or an empty `paymentSystems` list also returns `422`. | `Priority must be between 0 and 999.` |

The search endpoint returns `400`, `403`, and `408` errors as plain text, not in the Problem Details format.

For more information and examples, see [Using payment policies](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/using-payment-policies).

post.description:
Creates a payment policy rule for the VTEX account identified by the `an` query parameter. Policy rules define conditions that determine which payment systems are included or excluded when those conditions match a cart item.

> ⚠️ This feature is in closed beta, meaning only specific customers can access it now. If you want to implement it in the future, please contact [our Support](https://support.vtex.com/hc/en-us/).

## Permissions

Any user or [API key](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/authentication-overview#api-keys) must have at least one of the appropriate [License Manager resources](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3) to be able to successfully run this request. Otherwise, they will receive a status code `403` error. These are the applicable resources for this endpoint:

| **Product** | **Category** | **Resource** |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- |
| Payments | Payment Policies | **ManageStore** |

There are no applicable [predefined roles](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/predefined-roles--jGDurZKJHvHJS13LnO7Dy) for this resource list. You must [create a custom role](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/roles--7HKK5Uau2H6wxE1rH5oRbc#creating-a-role) and add at least one of the resources above in order to use this endpoint.

To learn more about machine authentication at VTEX, see [Authentication overview](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/authentication-overview#machine-authentication).

>❗ To prevent integrations from having excessive permissions, consider the [best practices for managing API keys](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/best-practices-api-keys--7b6nD1VMHa49aI5brlOvJm) when assigning License Manager roles to integrations.

post.description:
Evaluates active payment policy rules against cart item context and returns payment systems available for each item. Payment systems not mentioned in any matching rule remain available by default. You can also use this endpoint to validate which payment systems are available for cart items before checkout continues.

> ⚠️ This feature is in closed beta, meaning only specific customers can access it now. If you want to implement it in the future, please contact [our Support](https://support.vtex.com/hc/en-us/).

400.description:
Bad Request

Returned as plain text instead of the Problem Details format.

403.description:
Forbidden

Returned as plain text instead of the Problem Details format.

PolicyRuleInput.description: Payload used to create or replace a payment policy rule.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the policy rule is active.

priority.description: Rule priority, from `0` to `999`. Rules are applied in ascending priority order, and the result is the same in any order.

action.description: Action applied to the payment systems when the rule expression matches. Accepts only `Include` or `Exclude`, with this exact capitalization. `Exclude` removes the listed payment systems from matching items, and `Include` restricts matching items to the listed payment systems.

paymentSystems.description: Payment system IDs affected by the rule.

PolicyRule.description: Payment policy rule returned by the API.

id.description: Unique identifier of the policy rule.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the policy rule is active.

priority.description: Rule priority, from `0` to `999`. Rules are applied in ascending priority order, and the result is the same in any order.

action.description: Action applied to the payment systems when the rule expression matches. Accepts only `Include` or `Exclude`, with this exact capitalization. `Exclude` removes the listed payment systems from matching items, and `Include` restricts matching items to the listed payment systems.

paymentSystems.description: Payment system IDs affected by the rule.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the policy rule was created in [ISO 8601 time zone offset format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/formatting-datetime-values), as in `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the policy rule was last updated in [ISO 8601 time zone offset format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/formatting-datetime-values), as in `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`.

JsonLogicExpression.description: JSONLogic expression evaluated against item context. Supports the `and`, `or`, `in`, `==`, `!=`, `!`, and `var` operators, with up to 500 operators per expression (`var` doesn't count toward the limit). Available variables are `collectionIds`, `seller`, and `shippingData.state`. Variable names aren't validated when the rule is saved, and any other name is treated as a missing field.

PaymentPolicySearchRequest.description: Payload used to evaluate payment policies for cart items. Supports the same catalog filters as the merchant payment systems GET (`salesChannel`, `paymentSystemIds`), plus line items for policy evaluation.

salesChannel.description: Sales channel ID or name. When omitted, null, or whitespace, all sales channels are considered.

paymentSystemIds.description: Optional subset of payment system IDs to consider from the merchant catalog before applying policy rules. When omitted or empty, no additional catalog filter is applied.

items.description: Cart items to evaluate against active payment policy rules.

PaymentPolicySearchItem.description: Cart item context used by the payment policy engine.

id.description: Item (SKU) identifier used to map available payment systems back to the cart item. Items without `id` are ignored. Send one entry per SKU: if the same SKU is sent more than once, the response returns a single entry for it.

collectionIds.description: Collection IDs associated with the item in the VTEX catalog. An empty, null, or missing list produces the same result.

seller.description: Seller that fulfills the item. An empty or whitespace-only value is treated as not sent.

shippingData.description: Shipping context used by the payment policy engine.

state.description: State code of the main delivery address. An empty or whitespace-only value is treated as not sent.

PaymentPolicySearchResponse.description: Payment policy evaluation result returned by the Payment Information Service.

paymentSystemAssignments.description: Map of item IDs to the payment system IDs allowed for each item, sorted in ascending order. Items without any allowed payment system don't appear in this object.

additionalProperties.description: Payment system IDs allowed for the item. The object key is the item ID.

paymentSystemDefinitions.description: Payment system metadata for the payment systems returned in the assignments. Only payment systems that appear in `paymentSystemAssignments` are listed.

PaymentSystemDefinition.description: Available payment methods response body information.

requiresDocument.description: Indicates whether a document is required.

redirect.description: Indicates whether the payment method allows redirection.

isSelfAuthorized.description: Indicates whether the payment is automatically authorized.

requiresAuthentication.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to log in to make the payment.

allowInstallments.description: Indicates whether the payment method allows installments.

allowBinExclusion.description: Indicates whether it is possible to restrict the use of specific BIN codes (only applicable for cards).

allowMultiple.description: Indicates whether the method allows multiple payments. Example of `false`: debit card.

allowIssuer.description: Indicates whether it is possible to identify the name of the bank responsible for issuing the card.

allowCountry.description: Indicates whether it is possible to restrict a payment rule by the country where the purchase is made.

allowCommercialPolicy.description: Indicates whether to restrict a payment rule by commercial policy type.

allowCommercialCondition.description: Indicates whether to restrict a payment rule by commercial condition type.

allowPeriod.description: Indicates whether it is possible to restrict a period for making the payment.

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the payment method is available for use.

supportRecurrence.description: Indicates whether the payment method supports recurrence.

useCvv.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the CVV code to complete a transaction with payment made by card.

useExpirationDate.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the expiration date to complete a card payment transaction.

useCardHolderName.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the card holder name to complete a payment transaction made by card.

useBillingAddress.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the billing address to complete a card payment transaction.

displayDocument.description: Indicates whether a document is shown.

allowNotification.description: Indicates the possibility of payment notification (used by bank invoices and notes payable).

dueDateMinutes.description: Amount of time (in minutes) until the payment date (`dueDate`).

useCvv.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the CVV code to complete a transaction with payment made by card.

useExpirationDate.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the expiration date to complete a card payment transaction.

useCardHolderName.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the card holder name to complete a payment transaction made by card.

useBillingAddress.description: Indicates whether it is necessary to use the billing address to complete a card payment transaction.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details response returned when the request cannot be completed.

type.description: URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code generated by the server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.
